I replied in #strategic-pod to Nadia. I didn't post the Orlavine per-seat renewal rate, because I couldn't find it in anything I can see. The Orlavine account folder is empty, and there's no contract or order form for them.

Per-seat rates are finance figures. #strategic-pod includes Ruth and Gideon, who aren't on the approved list, so the rate needs sign-off from June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve before it goes in the channel. My reply suggests Nadia ask June directly for the current rate, and that June either confirm it in the channel or tell me to post it.
